summary: WindowOptions.MinSize Size (logical client pixels, per-dimension, zero = unconstrained) mirroring the reference WindowOptions::window_min_size; the Win32 host handles WM_GETMINMAXINFO (ported handle_get_min_max_info_msg): a set minimum raises MINMAXINFO.ptMinTrackSize to the logical minimum scaled at the current scale factor plus the frame offset (client-area adjusted), re-derived on every message so a scale-factor change re-clamps; a zero minimum falls to DefWindowProcW (exactly the pre-change path). SetBounds and the initial placement additionally clamp the client size explicitly; verified that Windows also clamps raw SetWindowPos to ptMinTrackSize, so the programmatic and interactive floors agree by construction.
